question: A family member spends 25% of his monthly income on food, 35% of the remaining on a home loan and other bank debts, and half of the rest on the education of the children. If the member saves $46,215 every year, then the monthly income of the member is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the monthly income be M. Using multiplying factors for successive remaining amounts:

Monthly Savings = M × (1 − 1/4) × (1 − 7/20) × (1 − 1/2)

Monthly Savings = M × (3/4) × (13/20) × (1/2) = 39M/160

Yearly Savings = 12 × (39M/160) = 468M/160 = $46,215

⇒ M = (46,215 × 160) ÷ 468 = $15,800

**∴ The correct answer is $15,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage spent on food = 25%

Percentage spent on home loan and debts = 35% of remaining

Percentage spent on education = 50% of the rest

Total savings per year = $46,215

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 − p₁/100) × (1 − p₂/100) × ...

Let the monthly income of the family member be x.

⇒ Monthly savings = Annual savings ÷ 12

⇒ Monthly savings = 46,215 ÷ 12 = $3,851.25

Applying the successive percentage change formula directly to find the remaining fraction:

⇒ Monthly savings = x × (100 − 25)/100 × (100 − 35)/100 × (100 − 50)/100

⇒ 3,851.25 = x × (75/100) × (65/100) × (50/100)

⇒ 3,851.25 = x × (3/4) × (13/20) × (1/2)

⇒ 3,851.25 = x × (39/160)

⇒ x = (3,851.25 × 160) ÷ 39

⇒ x = 616,200 ÷ 39

⇒ x = 15,800

**∴ The correct answer is $15,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is successively reduced by x%, y%, and z%, the final remaining value is calculated by multiplying the initial value by (1 − x/100)(1 − y/100)(1 − z/100). The fraction method is often faster than decimals.

Concept of Changing Base

In percentage problems involving the phrase "of the remaining", the base changes after every step. Direct addition or subtraction of the given percentages will lead to an incorrect result.

Annual vs Monthly Timeline Matching

Always align the timeframes for variables used in the same equation. If income and expenses are expressed on a monthly basis but savings are provided annually, you must divide the annual figure by 12 to normalize the data.
